title: Modeling Complex Systems
description: Building conceptual and quantitative models to understand how health and social systems behave over time. Current work includes HIV stigma and service engagement models, maternal health and service delivery redesign models, and translating qualitative systems work into quantitative simulation frameworks.

featuredPapers.title: Maternal Health & Service Delivery Redesign Modeling

title: Data & Inference
description: Using statistical modeling, estimation, and reweighting methods to learn from incomplete or biased health data. This includes MSM population estimation, survey-based inference, and bias correction through methods like IPF and raking.

featuredPapers.title: Reweighting & Bias Correction for Health Surveys

title: Decision Support & Tools
description: Designing outputs that make complex analyses usable for real-world decision-making, including dashboards, stakeholder-facing tools, and intervention-focused evaluation frameworks.
